description: Every selection a lead holds for a field that takes MORE THAN ONE value. One level from the lead, whichever section the field belongs to: a Table MultiSelect on a child table is a second level of child rows and Frappe persists one, so those rows neither loaded nor saved. A row is addressed by (Field Key, Row Key) and nothing else — the section, the label and the column name all come from the catalog row the Field Key names, so this table restates none of them.

fields.label: Field Key
fields.description: WHICH field this selection answers, as a Link into the field catalog. A Link and not free text: a key can then never name a section and a fieldname that do not belong together, and the label, the section and the column are read off that one row.

fields.label: Row Key
fields.description: WHICH row of the field's section this selection belongs to — the value of that section's Row Key Field, e.g. a cycle date. BLANK IS A REAL ADDRESS, not an unset one: a section holding one row per lead declares no row key, and many rows carry none.

fields.label: Value
fields.description: ONE selected value, still a real Link to the picklist master — so the vocabulary is the grain-scoped one every other picklist field reads, and the label resolves through the master's own title field.

name: CRM Lead Multi Value
